acquisition: Manual transcription of explicitly identified primary-paper tables and model parameters; not a downloaded yield grid or posterior.

mom_z14_model_parameters.location: physical-properties table and Section 3.2.2; conditional model inferences
mom_z14_model_parameters.note: Marginal endpoints are not a joint credible region. Cue excludes N IV], and its posteriors approach grid boundaries. The paper also gives a separate, stronger ionic-abundance estimate; it is not interchangeable with Cue.

sms_yields.original_yield_location: Nagele and Umeda (2023), Table 1, independently checked against the reproduction by Ebihara et al. (2026)
sms_yields.units: solar masses of ejected element, not abundance by number
sms_yields.note: Four discrete models, not a monotone mass interpolation. Equal retention is a scenario, especially uncertain for the explosion.

wr_time_benchmarks.note: Predictions tuned to GN-z11, not MoM-z14. Testing a history's clock does not exclude all WR stars.

vms_benchmark.note: LMC model estimate: not a numerical MoM-z14 yield grid. No carbon or oxygen ejecta is supplied here, so no complete N/C mixing prediction is assigned.

rotating_models.dilution_definition: mass of initially ambient ISM / ejected mass; not the fraction of SMS ejecta in a final mixture
rotating_models.note: Selected rounded benchmark ratios, not all rotations, IMFs, metallicities, ages, or mass cuts. Isotope ratio in the final row represents the reported 1.64-1.65 range by its midpoint.
